english.title: Drive a vehicle with no registration plate - registered before 1/10/38
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) drove a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), on a road, namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..), when the registration mark assigned to the vehicle by the Secretary of State under section 23(1) of the Vehicle Excise and Registration Act 1994 was not fixed in the manner prescribed by Regulation 7 of the Road Vehicles (Display of Registration Marks) Regulations 2001
english.legislation: Contrary to section 42(1) and (2) of the Vehicle Excise and Registration Act 1994.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
drove a vehicle registered before 1/10/1938 on a road
when the registration mark was not fixed in the prescribed manner

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) See Section 42(4) to (6) for defences
(ii) Regulation 7 applies to vehicles first registered before 1st October 1938. It does not apply to works trucks, road rollers and agricultural machines first registered before 1st October 1938.
(iii) Statement of Facts procedure applies - for wording see end of document.
(iv) This offence becomes applicable to the Fixed Penalty Ticket procedure as from 01/02/2011 - S.I.2010 / 2720.
